text: Giorgi Sharashidze - What kind of Vice Prime Minister and State Minister are we talking about? They don't even give him a normal cabinet, he won't have an office or a secretary - I would advise Mdinaradze not to get too carried away with this cabinet and to work remotely (28.04.2026, 12:04)

What kind of Vice Prime Minister and State Minister are we talking about? They don't even give Mdinaradze a normal cabinet, he won't have an office, and he won't have a secretary - I would advise him not to be too busy with this cabinet and to work remotely from home, - Giorgi Sharashidze, an MP from the "Gakharia for Georgia" party, said this while talking about the creation of the position of State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies. According to him, the appointment of a general coordinator will not change anything except that it will be his "temporary satisfaction and retirement."

"The planned changes have nothing to do with solving the problems of our citizens and the security issues of Georgia. This is another manifestation of informal governance. "Dream" and the 89 deputies sitting in parliament have nothing to do except to simply "smash" Ivanishvili's decisions, which no one agrees with them. What are we talking about as a vice-premier and state minister, they are not even giving him a normal cabinet, he will not have an office, and Mdinaradze will not have a secretary. I would advise him not to be too busy with this cabinet and to work remotely, from home.

If coordination is so important - the head of the State Security Service is not dismissed in six months for coordination. The State Security Service is not appointed for a six-year term by chance - this provision in the law is not accidental. We see that in the last year two heads of the State Security Service have already been changed. This indicates an unstable environment and informal governance. A person was given a generalship in one day in the morning and demoted to coordinator in the evening - what special expectations should we have from this person?

"As for the term coordinator - "Otsneba" itself introduced this term, and yesterday, at the meeting of the Legal Committee, one of our leaders, Giga Parulava, when he mentioned the fact that he was being referred to as a coordinator, there was such irritation, his vocabulary and tone were criticized. This coordinator is a term introduced by "Otsneba" and if it is offensive to them, then they should explain themselves where they got this term from. Therefore, when we say that this appointment of a general coordinator will not change anything except that it will simply be something to temporarily satisfy him and send him to retirement, this is reality," Sharashidze said.

For your information, the Parliament will urgently consider a draft law, based on which the position of State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be introduced within the Government of Georgia.
According to the project, the government administration will provide the material, technical and organizational support for the activities of the new state minister.

According to the Government's Parliamentary Secretary Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government resolution, which will specify his or her routine and strategic powers.
Mamuka Mdinaradze will be appointed as State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies.
